effect: Create a test-only proof registry; founder wallet becomes its administrator and issuer.
Bind the founder wallet as the test holder.
Create the test-only Token-2022 entitlement mint and configuration.
Sign and issue the first policy-bound test receipt.
Mint one non-transferable entitlement to the founder wallet.
Attempt replay; the consumer must reject it. Transaction fee still applies.
Sign and issue a second test receipt for a revocation probe.
Mint the second entitlement to the same founder wallet.
Attempt use with an unfunded, unrelated signer; the consumer must reject it. Transaction fee still applies.
Revoke the second receipt before authorized consumption.
Attempt to use the revoked receipt; the consumer must reject it. Transaction fee still applies.
Revoke the first receipt and close the test journey.
